items.name: connect-button
items.title: Connect Button
items.description: One button for the whole session lifecycle, driven by the Pipecat transport state. Every state's label, icon, style, and action can be overridden sparsely.
items.docs: Render inside a PipecatClientProvider. Without onConnect/onDisconnect it calls client.connect()/client.disconnect(); use stateProps to override individual transport states.

items.name: audio-visualizer-bar
items.title: Audio Visualizer Bar
items.description: Canvas-2D audio spectrum visualizer with mel-scale bands and the shared visualizer lifecycle states (connecting, silent, speaking, thinking). Headless view for any MediaStreamTrack, plus a Pipecat-connected wrapper.
items.docs: Use AudioVisualizerBar inside a PipecatClientProvider, or AudioVisualizerBarView with any MediaStreamTrack. Silent/speaking derive from the track; isConnecting/isThinking opt into the other shared states. Bars default to currentColor.

items.name: audio-visualizer-radial
items.title: Audio Visualizer Radial
items.description: Canvas-2D radial audio visualizer: a ring of spokes growing outward with mel-scale voice bands, sharing the kit visualizer lifecycle states (connecting, silent, speaking, thinking). Headless view for any MediaStreamTrack, plus a Pipecat-connected wrapper.
items.docs: Use AudioVisualizerRadial inside a PipecatClientProvider, or AudioVisualizerRadialView with any MediaStreamTrack. Silent/speaking derive from the track; isConnecting/isThinking opt into the other shared states. Spokes default to currentColor.

items.name: device-select
items.title: Device Select
items.description: Media device picker for microphones, speakers, or cameras — as a select or a dropdown menu around any trigger.
items.docs: DeviceSelect / DeviceDropdown pick their device list via kind: audioinput | audiooutput | videoinput. Render inside a PipecatClientProvider.

items.name: user-audio-control
items.title: User Audio Control
items.description: Microphone control with toggle and push-to-talk modes, live audio visualizer, and a mic/speaker device picker in a split-button dropdown.
items.docs: Render inside a PipecatClientProvider. Mic mute state, device errors, and the picker are wired automatically.

items.name: user-video-control
items.title: User Video Control
items.description: Camera toggle with preview tile and camera picker in a split-button dropdown.
items.docs: Render inside a PipecatClientProvider. Use noVideo for a plain toggle without the preview tile.

items.name: user-screen-control
items.title: User Screen Control
items.description: Screen-share toggle with a preview tile while sharing.
items.docs: Render inside a PipecatClientProvider. Disabled until the transport is connected.

items.name: bot-audio
items.title: Bot Audio
items.description: Bot audio output element with a shared volume store, mute toggle, horizontal or vertical volume slider, and a popover volume control.
items.docs: Mount BotAudioOutput once (in place of PipecatClientAudio), then use BotAudioControl or BotVolumeSlider anywhere. Render inside a PipecatClientProvider.

items.name: conversation
items.title: Conversation
items.description: Live scrolling transcript of the user/agent conversation with role labels, karaoke text rendering, function-call cards, and connection-aware empty states.
items.docs: Render inside a PipecatClientProvider. Pair with @pipecat/text-input for a full chat surface.

items.name: text-input
items.title: Text Input
items.description: Message composer with inline send button that injects the message into the conversation and sends it to the bot.
items.docs: Render inside a PipecatClientProvider. Disabled until connected; Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a newline in multiline mode.

items.name: transcript-overlay
items.title: Transcript Overlay
items.description: Caption-style overlay for bot speech with word-by-word fade-in and turn-end fade-out.
items.docs: Render inside a PipecatClientProvider. Requires a bot with RTVI 1.1.0+ (BotOutput events). Ensure tw-animate-css is imported in your globals.css.

items.name: client-status
items.title: Client Status
items.description: Client and agent connection status rows, live-updated from transport state and bot lifecycle events.
items.docs: Render inside a PipecatClientProvider.

items.name: session-info
items.title: Session Info
items.description: Session metadata rows: transport type, copyable ids, RTVI client/server versions.
items.docs: Render inside a PipecatClientProvider, with a TooltipProvider ancestor for the copy buttons.

items.name: dtmf-keypad
items.title: DTMF Keypad
items.description: Telephone keypad that sends DTMF tones — buffered sequence entry or immediate per-key dialing, with synthesized press feedback.
items.docs: Render inside a PipecatClientProvider. Disabled until the transport is ready; requires a bot with DTMF support (RTVI 2.0.0+).

items.name: use-pipecat-app
items.title: usePipecatApp
items.description: Client bootstrap hook: builds a PipecatClient for a chosen transport (loaded on demand), and owns the connect/disconnect lifecycle with startBot handling and real error state.
items.docs: Call above your PipecatClientProvider and pass the returned client to it. Transports are loaded on demand: install the @pipecat-ai/*-transport package for your transportType (the error message names the exact command).

items.name: use-pipecat-metrics
items.title: usePipecatMetrics
items.description: Shared store of RTVI metrics: per-processor ttfb/ttfa/processing/characters/stt_usage series with a rolling cap, running token totals (incl. cache-read and reasoning), and session-scoped reset.
items.docs: Render inside a PipecatClientProvider. Any number of subscribers share one listener per client; data survives unmounts and resets when a new session connects.

items.name: use-pipecat-event-stream
items.title: usePipecatEventStream
items.description: Shared RTVI event log: rAF-batched capture with a rolling cap, pause, clear-on-reconnect, and per-subscriber filtering and grouping.
items.docs: Render inside a PipecatClientProvider. Capture is shared — late-mounted subscribers see the backlog; filters, grouping, and onEvent are computed per subscriber.

items.name: metric
items.title: Metric
items.description: Single-datapoint metric tile — label, big tabular value, optional unit — fully generic and props-driven, chart-free by design.
items.docs: Metric is presentational: hand it any number via props. Pair with @pipecat/use-pipecat-metrics (usePipecatMetricValue) for live Pipecat values, or use the metrics block for the wired dashboard.

items.name: metrics
items.title: Metrics
items.description: Metrics dashboard block with a Performance/Usage tab navigator: per-processor latency tiles and charts, plus running token/character/audio usage totals, on the stock shadcn chart (recharts).
items.docs: Metrics reads the shared use-pipecat-metrics store inside a PipecatClientProvider; MetricsView takes fixtures. MetricsPerformance and MetricsUsage also export standalone. Chrome-free — wrap in your own card or panel.

items.name: console
items.title: Console
items.description: Full debugging console: header with connect flow, resizable bot-media / conversation+metrics / info panes over a live events strip, and a single-tree mobile tab layout.
items.docs: The console builds its own client via use-pipecat-app and renders its own PipecatClientProvider — do not nest it inside another provider. Install the @pipecat-ai/*-transport package for your transportType.
